gates.title: Threshold selection: captain>=185k and crew>=50% selected; sub-threshold not
gates.observable: fm_ctx_select picks a captain sentinel at total>=185k and a crew sentinel at used_pct>=50, and excludes sub-threshold sentinels

gates.title: Busy-guard: an over-threshold pane that is busy does NOT fire
gates.observable: fm_ctx_can_fire returns false for an eligible sentinel whose scratch tmux pane shows a busy footer

gates.title: Rehydrate: SessionStart with handoff injects+archives it; no-handoff path unchanged
gates.observable: bootstrap injects handoff additionalContext and archives it; with no handoff a captain pane still gets captain ctx and no rehydrate block

gates.title: E2E on scratch pane: threshold -> checkpoint -> handoff -> /clear -> rehydrate
gates.observable: fm_ctx_fire_once sends the checkpoint instruction into a scratch pane, waits for the handoff, issues /clear, and the bootstrap rehydrates from it

gates.title: Inject cap: handoff under 10k injected verbatim, over 10k yields a pointer
gates.observable: fm_ctx_inject_payload and the bootstrap emit the handoff verbatim under the cap and a short file pointer over it

gates.title: Verdict grammar: only approve/reject/escalate/lens lines; last-decision and reject-count read correctly
gates.observable: fm_verdict_append refuses an invalid kind; fm_verdict_last ignores lens lines; fm_verdict_reject_count counts only reject lines

gates.title: fm-merge-local refuses without a trailing approve verdict; approve merges; override is loud
gates.observable: fm-merge-local exits 1 with the QUARTERDECK banner when state/<id>.verdict is missing or ends in reject, fast-forwards on approve, and honors FM_VERIFY_OVERRIDE=1 with a warning banner

gates.title: fm-pr-check refuses to arm the merge poll without a trailing approve verdict
gates.observable: fm-pr-check exits 1 with the QUARTERDECK banner and writes no state/<id>.check.sh when the verdict is missing/reject; arms it on approve

gates.title: fm-verify: approve path records approve; reject relays findings to the crewmate and exits 2; non-ship tasks skip
gates.observable: with a stubbed verifier and relay, a reject verdict appends 'reject: (attempt 1 of 3)', the relay receives the QUARTERDECK REJECTED message, exit is 2; an approve verdict appends approve and exits 0; kind=scout skips with exit 0

gates.title: Third reject escalates instead of spinning; at-cap tasks escalate without re-running the verifier
gates.observable: with two prior rejects a rejecting stub yields reject #3 AND an escalate line with exit 3; with three prior rejects fm-verify escalates immediately and the verifier stub is never invoked

gates.title: No Fugu key + no codex -> lens degrades to none loudly; verify still completes
gates.observable: with FUGU_API_KEY unset, no FM_LENS_CMD, and codex absent from PATH, fm-verify logs a degradation warning, records 'lens: none', and still reaches an approve verdict

gates.title: Verifier infrastructure failure escalates - never approves
gates.observable: a verifier command that exits non-zero, or exits 0 with no VERDICT line, yields an escalate verdict and exit 3; the verdict file never gains an approve

gates.title: Intake grammar: only proceed/revise/escalate/panel lines; last-decision ignores panel lines and no-decision files
gates.observable: fm_intake_append refuses an invalid kind; fm_intake_last ignores panel lines and returns 1 on missing file or decision-free file; fm_intake_revise_count counts only revise lines

gates.title: fm-spawn refuses a ship task without a trailing intake proceed; scout exempt; override loud
gates.observable: with a brief present, a ship spawn with missing/revise-last intake exits non-zero with the WARDROOM banner before any side effect; proceed-last and --scout pass the gate; FM_INTAKE_OVERRIDE=1 bypasses with a warning banner

gates.title: fm-intake: both thinkers proceed -> proceed + synthesis; one revise -> revise with count; exit codes 0/2
gates.observable: with stubbed thinkers and lens, both-proceed appends 'proceed:' and exits 0 with intake-review.md written; a revising thinker appends 'revise: (revise 1 of 2)' and exits 2

gates.title: Second revise escalates; at-cap intakes escalate without running the panel; a PANEL-less thinker escalates, never proceeds
gates.observable: with one seeded revise, a revising stub yields revise #2 AND an escalate line with exit 3; with two seeded revises the panel stub is never invoked; a thinker emitting no PANEL line yields escalate with no proceed line

gates.title: Intake with no Fugu key + no codex degrades the lens to none loudly; intake still completes
gates.observable: under env -i with FUGU_API_KEY stripped and codex absent from PATH, fm-intake logs a degradation warning, records 'panel: lens none', and still reaches a proceed decision from stubbed thinkers

gates.title: Wake drain appends a run-log JSON line and stamps STATE.md; FM_LOOP_LOG=0 disables; log failure never breaks the drain
gates.observable: a drain of a queued record appends a parseable JSON line with items_found to loop-run-log.md and rewrites STATE.md Last run; FM_LOOP_LOG=0 leaves both untouched; an unwritable log target does not change the drain output or exit code

gates.title: loop-audit scores the repo at level L2 or better (score >= 58)
gates.observable: the globally installed loop-audit CLI reports level L2 or L3 with score >= 58 for the repo root; a stripped copy (no STATE.md/LOOP.md) scores lower and fails the same assertion

gates.title: Boot-time reconciliation digest in captain context; fm-watch-arm --status read-only
gates.observable: SessionStart captain block carries the reconciliation digest (lock-free wake-queue depth+records with torn-tail rule, verbatim fm-watch-arm --status and fm-lock status relays, in-flight metas with last status, afk flag, exact snapshot disclaimer, ~2000-char cap with explicit +N-more marker); non-captain unchanged; --status is one-line/exit-0 and side-effect-free

gates.title: Gate harness loads: gates/ledger.json is an array, and a broken ledger fails loudly
gates.observable: gates/ledger.json's top-level `gates` is a JSON array (read directly from the checked-in file, never by invoking ledger against gates/), and against isolated fixture dirs under a temp root a ledger whose `gates` is an object makes `ledger verify --dir <fixture>` exit non-zero and name the schema violation on stderr, while its well-formed twin does not trip that validator. The fixture runs leave this repo's gates/ledger.json and gates/LEDGER.md byte-identical.

gates.title: bin/fm-boot-context.sh is registered as a real SessionStart hook
gates.observable: The rendered ~/.claude/settings.json declares a SessionStart hook whose command names fm-boot-context.sh, that path is executable, and the declared timeout is 10. Asserting on direct invocation of the emitter is explicitly forbidden by this gate: such a test goes green while a real session still boots blind. BLOCKED ON ANOTHER REPO - mac-config renders that settings file and deletes undeclared keys, so registration is a declared change there, not an edit here. Goes green on `stone apply` with no further firstmate change.

gates.title: A full boot through bin/fm-boot-context.sh performs zero writes
gates.observable: Writable arm: a full recursive manifest (path, type, size, mtime, ctime, inode, mode) of the firstmate home is byte-identical before and after a full boot, with the handoff and resume directive - the two files fm-captain-bootstrap.sh moves and deletes - still in place and no handoff-archive created. Read-only arm: with the home, its state/, its data/ and the fleet-view dir held read-only via chmod a-w (fs_usage needs root and macOS has no bind mounts), the same boot still exits 0 and still emits a valid non-empty SessionStart envelope carrying the fleet section.

gates.title: Boot holds its budget by enforced deadline and concurrent helpers, leaks nothing, and never elides a peer
gates.observable: HOSTILE PATH - every helper reachable through FM_BOOTSTRAP_BIN stubbed to hang and 12 synthetic peers (one corrupt, one long stale): the emitter exits 0, prints a valid SessionStart envelope, keeps additionalContext under the 10,000-char cap, renders an explicit UNAVAILABLE marker per unreachable helper, lists all 12 peers (a peer is never elided), performs zero execs on the peer path, survives a peer with a 20,000-char field, and states the choice out loud when a 200-peer fleet forces the cap and the never-elide rule apart. It leaks NO process: a wedged helper is killed as a process group, checked after a bounded settle because killing is asynchronous. BUDGET is asserted through properties the code controls, NOT a wall-clock threshold: the deadline is ENFORCED (helpers wedged for 999s cost seconds, bounded at 15s - 3x clearance below and 66x above, and the pre-split serial design at ~10.3s is still caught), and the helper phase is CONCURRENT (each stub records its start instant; concurrent starts are milliseconds apart against a whole-allowance serial signature, measured 0.386s versus 5s). Elapsed wall clock is deliberately not asserted: measured on one host it swings 0.55s to 4.5s with load alone (130 to 205), so a second-scale threshold asserts a property of the machine. Every boot's elapsed time is printed. NORMAL PATH - real helpers, nothing stubbed: a valid envelope, the fleet rendered, ZERO network calls, at most two helper execs for the whole boot however many peers exist, and none of them attributable to a peer. Its latency is measured and printed but not asserted; END-GOAL condition 2's sub-second figure is recorded as NOT machine-checked, with the reasons, in docs/specs/2026-08-27-n-concurrent-firstmates.md.

gates.title: A section that fails to build says so; failure is never silent
gates.observable: When a section builder raises, the emitter still emits and the output carries an explicit UNAVAILABLE marker naming both the failed section and the reason, while the remaining sections still render. A healthy boot carries no such marker, so the marker is meaningful. Replaces the bare `except: pass` that dropped the whole digest, which made a boot that lost all fleet context look identical to a healthy one.

gates.title: CI skips a test only when its gate is red AND declared accepted
gates.observable: tests/run-all.sh skips a gate's test only when BOTH the gate's status is 'red' in gates/ledger.json AND its id is declared with a reason in gates/accepted-red.md. A gate that is red but undeclared still runs, still fails, and still fails the suite; a declared gate that is green still runs; a missing or unparseable ledger skips nothing at all; and every skip prints a visible line naming the gate, the test and the reason, with the counts in the summary.

gates.title: Status reporting is a verb a crewmate whose redirect is refused can still use
gates.observable: Under a policy that refuses any command redirecting into the firstmate home - the modelled form of deny Edit(~/firstmate/**), which the harness applies to Bash - the old `echo "..." >> <home>/state/<id>.status` form is refused while the status command fm-brief.sh actually emits - extracted from a generated brief rather than restated, so the gate cannot drift from it - is permitted, and running that emitted command under an ambient environment naming a different home still appends the line to the home the brief pinned. The verb resolves the home via FM_HOME/FM_STATE_OVERRIDE like the rest of bin/, appends rather than truncates, writes exactly one line per call so an embedded newline cannot forge extra wakes, and refuses an empty message or a traversing id. Every brief fm-brief.sh generates - ship, scout and secondmate - teaches the verb and none teaches the redirect form.
